name: category_tree
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", parent_id AS "parentId", parent_path AS "parentPath", name->>'en_US' AS name FROM product_category ORDER BY id

name: categories_per_parent
source_sql: SELECT parent_id AS "parentId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_category GROUP BY parent_id ORDER BY parent_id

name: tags_by_sequence
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", name->>'en_US' AS name, sequence, color, visible_to_customers AS "visibleToCustomers" FROM product_tag ORDER BY sequence, id

name: base_units_by_name
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", name->>'en_US' AS name FROM product_base_unit ORDER BY name->>'en_US'
